vocabulary.definition: becomes active, popular, or important again
vocabulary.example: The old tradition of hand-written letters revives during the holiday season.

vocabulary.definition: the ideological barrier that existed between Eastern and Western Europe during the Cold War
vocabulary.example: The fall of the Berlin Wall marked the end of the Iron Curtain era.

vocabulary.definition: to watch, keep track of, or check for a specific purpose
vocabulary.example: The security cameras monitor the entrance of the building 24/7.

vocabulary.definition: the movement of people from one place to another, especially for the purpose of settling in a new location
vocabulary.example: Bird migration is a fascinating natural phenomenon studied by scientists.
Smoking is forbidden in this area due to fire safety regulations.

vocabulary.definition: fitted with electric power or equipment; charged with electricity
vocabulary.example: The fence around the high-security prison is electrified to prevent escapes.
